text:
Aria Nguyen: quick sync — we're being asked to finalize cuts for Nimbus MVP. I propose deferring Query Builder (visual UI) to v1 and shipping a lightweight query API + example dashboard. Target milestone: 2026-06-01. Thoughts?
Tom Becker: customers expect builder but we can offer a templated dashboard that consumes the API — lower dev cost. Will pilots accept that?
Samira Khan: ACME needs builder for onboarding. But if we provide migration docs + 2 sample dashboards they can use immediately, it's probably ok.
Aria Nguyen: tradeoffs: Keep Builder => +3w delay. Defer => preserve milestone. Option 1: API+templates (MVP). Option 2: full builder (slip) — prefer 1.
Tom Becker: add rollout gates: 1) API p95 <180ms, 2) onboarding success rate >=85% for pilot cohort, 3) no P0s for 5 business days.
Samira Khan: I'll handle onboarding success metric and pilot comms. Suggest we mark UI as "preview" and include a short feedback survey in the pane.
ops-bot: Created RFC R-8712: "Nimbus: Query Builder deferral vs MVP templates" assigned to @Aria and @Samira.
Aria Nguyen: dev notes: expose feature flag nimbus.query_ui=preview, retention for templates s3_prefix=nimbus/mvp_templates, and default cache_mode=compact. Dev estimate: API+templates 2.5w, UI builder 3.5w.
Tom Becker: also add rollback if error rate >0.8% on write paths during canary.
product-bot: Opened ticket INF-4020: "Nimbus MVP: templates-first decision" https://redwood.internal/INF-4020
Samira Khan: I'll draft comms + onboarding checklist by Wed. Recon Friday to confirm final decision. :thumbsup:
